response.original_text:
AIR QUALITY UPDATE
As of 12:00 NN on Sunday, Sept. 20, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources–Environmental Management Bureau (DENR-EMB) continues to closely monitor air quality in several areas in the Philippines affected by haze.
The observed haze is possibly associated with smoke and transboundary haze from ongoing fires in Kalimantan, Indonesia, which may have been transported toward the Philippines by prevailing winds.
Courtesy: EMB Central Office/Facebook
Visit www.gmanetwork.com/news for updates
